items.headline: Buckley runs for a pair of TDs to give Western Michigan 21-14 win over Central Michigan
items.description: — Jalen Buckley ran for 150 yards and two touchdowns to lead Western Michigan to a 21-14 win over Central Michigan on Saturday.

items.headline: Nick Poulos throws 3 TD passes, helps Ohio beat Central Michigan 31-14 for 16th straight win at home
items.description: — Nick Poulos threw three first-half touchdown passes and Ohio extended the nation's second longest current home winning streak to 16 with a 31-14 victory over Central Michigan on a rainy Saturday.
